intro.text: Welcome aboard! Our ship doesn't ask for passwords. It asks for something much rarer: a little light. Let's see if you have some.

touch.text: Each of you has half a screen, half a sky. Touch the light in front of you. See? It answered. You can just watch if you like. That's all the stars ever do.

age-5-10-practice.text: The ship has lost a piece. Ships do that when they can't wait to leave. Find the matching shape on your screen and tap it. Ships are repaired with patience, not hurry.

age-10-15-practice.text: A signal keeps repeating. What is it telling us? Look at the gaps between signals. Choose the answer that matches what you see, then confirm.

age-15-18-practice.text: Every decision starts with a proposal. Read the situation on your screen, choose what you think is appropriate, then confirm. Next, we'll see how we work together.

adults-practice.text: A good choice starts with a question. Look at the information and the displayed cost. Choose, then confirm. This is just practice. The mission loses nothing.

legacy-v3-practice.text: Look at the clue on your screen. Find the star, then confirm. This is just a warm-up.

cooperate.text: Now, everyone: touch the signal on your half of the screen. Look ahead. Every touch lights up a part of the ship. That's how a crew is born: lights answering one another.

ready.text: The controls are responding. Take a deep breath. Somewhere far away, three worlds await us, and a question older than every ship.

handoff.text: The crew is ready, Commander. We're ready to depart.

hint.text: Look for the glowing spot on your half of the screen. Take your time. Stars don't hurry. And if you need help, the operator is here.

finale.text: The journey lives on in what you choose now. Three gifts await you: a light, care for others, an explorer's courage. Choose yours and send it. Each gift lights a ray in Humanity's Star. Your ray. You set out to find other worlds. You returned with your own, seen for the first time.
